name: Bounded Execution of Rasterization
definition: A rasterization strategy that partitions the image into non-overlapping leaves to bound peak memory usage by processing leaves sequentially, releasing local state after each leaf, and accumulating gradients into a shared buffer.
summary: Bounded Execution of Rasterization is a memory-constrained strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that partitions images into leaves to bound peak memory by processing them sequentially and separating rasterization from projection backward passes.
